items.q:
Mina asks a person on the street.
A: Excuse me, where is the library?
B: ___
o: It is next to the bakery.
items.why: Where로 물었으니 장소를 알려 주는 “It is next to the bakery.”가 알맞아요.
items.hint: Where는 ‘어디’를 묻는 말이에요. 위치를 알려 주는 대답을 찾으세요.

items.q:
A: How can I get to the post office?
B: ___
o: It is open every day, I think.
Go straight, and turn left at the hospital.
Yes, I have a letter for you.
The post office is very old.
items.why: 길을 묻는 말에는 가는 방법을 말해 줘요. “Go straight, and turn left at the hospital.”이 길 안내예요.
items.hint: How can I get to ~?는 가는 방법을 묻는 말이에요.

items.q:
A: Is the bus stop far from here?
B: ___
o: No, it is just across the street.
items.why: far(멀리)인지 묻는 말에 “No, it is just across the street.”(아니요, 바로 길 건너예요)가 알맞아요.
items.hint: ‘멀어요?’라는 질문에 거리로 답하는 말을 고르세요.

items.q:
A: I have a bad fever and my head hurts.
B: Let's go to the ___.
items.why: 열이 나고 머리가 아플 때는 병원(hospital)에 가요.
items.hint: 아플 때 의사를 만나러 가는 곳은 어디일까요?

items.q: Jun wants to see old paintings and tools from long ago. Where should he go?
items.why: 오래된 그림과 도구를 보는 곳은 박물관(museum)이에요.
items.hint: 오래된 물건을 전시하는 곳을 떠올려 보세요.

items.q: Dad says, “I need to send this box to Grandma.” Where does he go?
items.why: 소포를 보내는 곳은 우체국(post office)이에요.
items.hint: 상자를 다른 도시로 보내려면 어디에 가야 할까요?

items.q:
A: Go straight, and the museum is on your left.
B: ___
o: I am sorry, I am late.
items.why: 길을 알려 준 사람에게는 “Thank you for your help!”라고 고마움을 말해요.
items.hint: 길을 알려 준 사람에게 어떤 말을 하는 게 좋을까요?

items.q:
A: Excuse me. Is there a bakery near here?
B: ___
o: Yes, I do. I like bread.
Yes, there is one next to the bank.
No, I am not. I am a student.
Yes, it does. It is good.
items.why: Is there ~?에는 Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.로 답해요.
items.hint: Is there ~?로 물으면 there를 써서 답해요.

items.q:
At a bus stop, a visitor asks the driver.
A: Which bus goes to the museum?
B: ___
o: Take Bus 7. It stops in front of the museum.
The museum is closed on Monday, I think.
Please come in and sit down here.
The bus is red and very clean today.
items.why: 어느 버스인지 물었으니 “Take Bus 7.”처럼 버스 번호를 말해 줘요.
items.hint: Which bus ~?는 어떤 버스인지 묻는 말이에요.

items.q: Ken answers, “It is between the bank and the park.” Which question did Ken hear?
items.why: 위치로 답했으니 Where로 시작하는 질문 “Where is the school?”이 알맞아요.
items.hint: 대답이 ‘어디에 있는지’를 말하고 있어요.

items.q: Someone answers, “Turn left at the corner.” Which question fits?
o: How can I get to the bakery?
What time does the bakery open?
items.why: 길 안내이므로 가는 방법을 묻는 “How can I get to the bakery?”가 알맞아요.
items.hint: ‘왼쪽으로 도세요’는 가는 방법을 알려 주는 말이에요.

items.q: The answer is “Yes, it is next to the post office.” Which question fits?
o: Is the bus stop next to the post office?
Who is at the post office?
items.why: Yes로 시작하는 대답이므로 Yes/No로 묻는 “Is the bus stop next to the post office?”가 알맞아요.
items.hint: Yes로 시작하는 대답에는 어떤 형태의 질문이 어울릴까요?

items.q: Sora hears, “It is on the second floor, behind the stairs.” What did she ask?
o: Who is in the art room?
What time is the art room?
How many art rooms are there?
items.why: 층과 계단 뒤라는 위치를 답했으니 Where로 물은 질문이에요.
items.hint: 대답에 층과 위치가 나와 있어요.

items.q:
Row 1: bank | park | school
Row 2: bakery | hospital | museum
(Each place in Row 2 is right below the place in Row 1.)

Which place is right below the park?
items.why: Row 1의 두 번째가 park이고, 그 바로 아래(Row 2의 두 번째)가 hospital이에요.
items.hint: 두 번째 칸끼리 위아래로 맞춰 보세요.

items.q:
Row 1: museum | bakery | park
Row 2: bank | bus stop | hospital
(Row 2 is right below Row 1.)

Which sentence is true?
o: The park is above the bank.
The bakery is above the bus stop.
The hospital is between the bank and the bus stop.
The museum is next to the hospital.
items.why: 가운데 칸에서 bakery가 bus stop 바로 위에 있어요.
items.hint: 각 보기의 칸 위치를 하나씩 확인해 보세요.

items.q:
Main Street, from left to right: post office, library, bus stop, bakery, bank.

Which place is between the bus stop and the bank?
items.why: 왼쪽에서부터 bus stop, bakery, bank 순서라서 bakery가 둘 사이에 있어요.
items.hint: 오른쪽 끝에서 두 번째 자리를 보세요.

items.q:
Elm Street has two sides.
North side (left to right): library | bakery | hospital
South side (left to right): bus stop | bank | museum
A place is across from the place in the same position on the other side.

What is across from the bakery?
items.why: 북쪽 가운데가 bakery이고 남쪽 가운데가 bank라서 서로 마주 보고 있어요.
items.hint: 같은 순서(몇 번째)에 있는 건물끼리 마주 봐요.

items.q:
Main Street has a left side and a right side.
Left side, first to last: bank, bakery
Right side, first to last: park, museum

Which place is the first on the right side?
items.why: 오른쪽 길의 첫 번째 장소는 park이에요.
items.hint: ‘right side’ 줄만 보세요.

items.q:
Mina starts at the bus stop and walks straight. She passes the bank, then the bakery, and stops at the next place, the hospital.

Which place does she pass right before the hospital?
items.why: bank, bakery 다음이 hospital이므로 바로 앞은 bakery예요.
items.hint: 지나간 순서를 차례대로 적어 보세요.

items.q:
Tom is at the school. The bakery is in front of the school. The park is behind the school. The hospital is next to the school.

Which place is behind the school?
items.why: “The park is behind the school.”에서 park가 학교 뒤에 있어요.
items.hint: behind는 ‘뒤에’라는 뜻이에요.

items.q:
From left to right: zoo, cafe, toy shop, bank, school.

Which place is second from the right?
items.why: 오른쪽 끝이 school이고 그 왼쪽 옆, 즉 오른쪽에서 두 번째가 bank예요.
items.hint: 오른쪽 끝부터 세어 보세요.

items.q:
Signs at a corner:
Bakery - turn right
Hospital - go straight
Park - turn left

Mina has a stomachache and needs a doctor. What should she do?
items.why: 의사를 만나려면 hospital로 가야 하고, 표지판이 straight(곧장)라고 알려 줘요.
items.hint: 의사가 있는 곳이 어디인지 먼저 찾으세요.

items.q:
Notice: Lost your way? Ask at the desk next to the front door. Maps are on the wall behind the desk.

Where are the maps?
o: On the wall behind the desk.
items.why: “Maps are on the wall behind the desk.”라고 쓰여 있어요.
items.hint: Maps가 나오는 문장만 다시 읽어 보세요.

items.q:
Mina: I am at the bus stop. Where are you?
Jun: I am in front of the bakery.
Mina: I see it! It is across the street from me.

Where is the bakery?
o: Across the street from the bus stop.
items.why: 미나가 버스 정류장에 있고 빵집이 길 건너편에 있다고 했어요.
items.hint: 미나가 있는 곳을 기준으로 생각해 보세요.

items.q:
Jina's desk has a lamp on it. A bag is under the chair. A ball is under the desk. A cat is on the bed.

Which object is under the desk?
items.why: “A ball is under the desk.” 책상 아래에 있는 것은 공이에요.
items.hint: under 뒤에 desk가 나오는 문장을 찾으세요.

items.q:
In Jun's room, the clock is on the wall above the bed. The shoes are next to the door. The robot is between the bed and the desk.

Where is the robot?
o: Between the bed and the desk.
items.why: 로봇은 침대와 책상 사이에 있어요.
items.hint: robot이 나오는 문장만 보세요.

items.q:
In our kitchen, the milk is in the fridge. The bread is on the table. The cups are in the cupboard. The apples are in a bowl next to the bread.

Where are the apples?
o: In a bowl next to the bread.
items.why: 사과는 빵 옆에 있는 그릇 안에 있어요.
items.hint: apples가 나오는 마지막 문장을 보세요.

items.q:
Three things are in a row on a shelf: a book, a clock and a plant. The book is next to the clock. The plant is not next to the book.

Which one is in the middle?
items.why: 책은 시계 옆이고 식물은 책 옆이 아니므로 순서는 책, 시계, 식물이고 시계가 가운데예요.
items.hint: 식물이 책 옆이 아니라면 어디에 있을까요?

items.q:
My bag has a small pocket on the front. My keys are in the pocket. My lunch box is inside the bag, under my books.

Which thing is at the bottom of the bag?
items.why: 도시락은 책 아래, 가방 안쪽 바닥에 있어요.
items.hint: under my books를 보세요.

items.q:
In the park, a dog is under the bench. A bird is on the bench. A boy is behind the bench.

Who or what is behind the bench?
items.why: “A boy is behind the bench.” 벤치 뒤에 있는 것은 소년이에요.
items.hint: behind는 ‘뒤에’예요.

items.q: We wait for the school bus ___ the bus stop every morning.
items.why: 버스 정류장처럼 한 지점에서 기다릴 때는 at the bus stop이라고 해요.
items.hint: 정류장은 한 ‘지점’으로 생각해 보세요.

items.q: The cat is sleeping ___ the blanket, so I cannot see it.
items.why: 담요 때문에 고양이가 안 보이니 담요 아래(under)에 있어요.
items.hint: 고양이가 보이지 않는다는 말에 주목하세요.

items.q: The museum is ___ the bakery and the hospital, so you can see both from the door.
items.why: 두 건물 사이에 있을 때는 between A and B로 말해요.
items.hint: and로 두 장소가 이어져 있어요.

items.q: There are thirty students ___ my class.
items.why: 반 안에 있는 학생 수를 말할 때는 in my class라고 해요.
items.hint: 교실 ‘안’의 구성원을 말하고 있어요.

items.q: Excuse me, is there a bank ___ here?
items.why: “near here”는 ‘이 근처에’라는 뜻이에요.
items.hint: 길을 가다 은행이 가까이에 있는지 묻는 말이에요.

items.q: Please write your name ___ the top of the page.
items.why: 페이지의 맨 위 지점은 at the top of the page라고 해요.
items.hint: top of the page는 한 지점을 가리켜요.

items.q: Wow! There are many colorful fish ___ the water.
items.why: 물속에 있는 물고기는 in the water라고 해요.
items.hint: 물고기는 물의 안쪽에 있어요.

items.q: Sam says, “The ball is in the box.” Where is the ball?
items.why: in the box는 상자 안에 있다는 뜻이에요.
items.hint: in과 on을 구별해 보세요.

items.q: Which one is NOT used to tell where something is?
items.why: because는 이유를 말하는 말이고, 나머지는 위치를 말해요.
items.hint: 이유를 나타내는 말은 무엇일까요?

items.q: Mina says, “Stop at the corner of the street.” What is a corner here?
o: A round table in a living room.
A kind of fresh bread, too.
The place where two streets meet.
A big bus for school children.
items.why: corner는 길과 길이 만나는 모퉁이를 뜻해요.
items.hint: street(길)와 어울리는 뜻을 찾으세요.

items.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
o: The museum is behind the school.
The bus stop is next the bank.
The bakery is across from the hospital.
The park is between the bank and the zoo.
items.why: next 뒤에는 to가 필요해요. next to the bank가 맞아요.
items.hint: next 뒤에 빠진 말이 있는 문장을 찾으세요.

items.q: Which sentence tells a person the way correctly?
items.why: Turn right at the bakery.가 올바른 순서예요.
items.hint: 동사 다음에 방향이 와요.

items.q:
Put the sentences in order.
1. Then turn left at the bakery.
2. First, go straight for two minutes.
3. The library is on your right.
4. Excuse me, where is the library?
items.why: 질문(4), 먼저 직진(2), 그다음 좌회전(1), 도서관 위치(3) 순서예요.
items.hint: First와 Then의 순서를 생각하세요.

items.q: “Turn right at the bank.”의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
items.why: turn right는 오른쪽으로 돈다는 뜻이고, at the bank는 은행에서라는 뜻이에요.
items.hint: right와 left를 구별하세요.

items.q: Which is the most polite way to ask a stranger for help?
o: Hey you, tell me the museum now.
Excuse me, can you help me find the museum?
items.why: 처음 보는 사람에게는 Excuse me로 시작해 공손하게 물어요.
items.hint: 처음 보는 사람에게 말을 걸 때 쓰는 인사를 떠올리세요.

items.good: Go straight and turn left at the corner.
bad: Go straight and turn left in the corner.
Go straight and turn at left the corner.
Goes straight and turn left at the corner.

cz.st: Go straight and turn left ___ the corner.

items.rule: 길 안내에서 ‘모퉁이에서 돌아라’는 turn left at the corner라고 해요. 명령문에는 -s를 붙이지 않아요.
items.hint: 길을 알려 주는 명령문에서 쓰는 전치사를 생각해 보세요.

items.good: There is a bus stop in front of the museum.
bad: There are a bus stop in front of the museum.
There is a bus stop front of the museum.
There is bus stop in front of the museum.

cz.st: There ___ a bus stop in front of the museum.

items.rule: 하나(a bus stop)가 있을 때는 There is를 써요. ‘~ 앞에’는 in front of예요.
items.hint: a bus stop이 하나인지 여러 개인지 보세요.

bad: Where the toy shop is?
Where is toy shop the?
Where are the toy shop?
items.rule: 장소를 물을 때는 Where 다음에 is와 주어를 차례로 써요. bakery는 하나이므로 is예요.
items.hint: Where 바로 뒤에 어떤 동사가 오는지 생각해 보세요.

items.good: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?
bad: Excuse me, how I can get to the museum?
Excuse me, how can I get the museum?
Excuse me, how can get I to the museum?

cz.st: Excuse me, how can I get ___ the museum?

items.rule: get to ~는 ‘~에 도착하다, 가다’예요. 의문사 다음에는 can I의 순서로 써요.
items.hint: ‘~에 가다’의 get 뒤에 오는 말을 떠올리세요.

items.good: She lives near the bus stop.
bad: She live near the bus stop.
She lives near of the bus stop.
She near lives the bus stop.
items.rule: near는 그 자체로 ‘~ 가까이에’라는 뜻이라서 of를 붙이지 않아요. She는 한 명이므로 lives예요.
items.hint: near 뒤에 다른 말이 필요한지 생각해 보세요.

items.good: My bag is under the chair.
bad: My bag is under chair.
My bag under is the chair.
My bag is the under chair.
items.rule: ‘~ 아래에’는 under예요. 장소 말은 the chair 앞에 와요.
items.hint: 가방이 의자의 어느 쪽에 있는지 생각해 보세요.

items.good: Is there a post office near here?
bad: Is there post office near here?
Are there a post office near here?
Is a post office there near here?

cz.st: Is there a post office ___ here?

items.rule: 하나가 있는지 물을 때는 Is there a ~?를 써요. ‘이 근처에’는 near here예요.
items.hint: ‘근처에’라는 뜻의 말을 고르세요.

items.ex: We saw old coins at the museum.
I buy fresh bread at the bakery.
My aunt works at the hospital.
I read picture books at the library.
